data.narrative:
ICEYE is a Series F space and aerospace company valued at €10.5B (~$12.0B post-money) that has raised $650M+ to date. The valuation assessment draws on a comparable universe of five same-sector peers spanning public equities (Rocket Lab at $40.0B, Planet Labs at $7.6B, Firefly Aerospace at $2.9B) and private companies (Sierra Space at $8.0B, Impulse Space at $4.3B).

The stage-progression method proved inapplicable; the stated $12.0B base valuation implies a multiple exceeding 20x total capital raised, suggesting a likely data error. The peer-median approach is the primary triangulation method applied here. Across five comparable firms in equivalent sector and valuation tier, the median valuation stands at $7.6B, with a range spanning $2.9B to $40.0B. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples (sector median 27.4x across six public tickers) cannot be applied absent ICEYE's revenue disclosure, typical for private companies.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $6.4B to $8.7B, centered on the peer median of $7.6B. This implies a material discount to the stated $12.0B post-money valuation. Key uncertainties include ICEYE's revenue trajectory and margin profile relative to public-market comparables, as well as potential selection bias in the five-peer sample. The wide spread in the comparable set ($2.9B–$40.0B) reflects genuine heterogeneity in space-sector valuations and underscores execution risk as a primary valuation driver.
